description: Slicer parameters a requirement profile may bound — the keys of a manifest's requirements.process_parameters (top level and per part). Every key is OrcaSlicer's own config key, verified against its PrintConfig.cpp at a pinned revision and recorded with the line that defines it, so a requirement can be applied to a slicer profile without a translation table.

review.note: Key set, cross-maps, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (P3-LEX lane, 2026-10-02) against SEM-1 §4. No language facet of any entry has had a native review: every entry says `generated`, and Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were checked against the cited sources on the access date; no ruling has been made by a human.

sources.title: OrcaSlicer PrintConfig.cpp — definition of `bed_temperature`
sources.supports: the key's name, option type, unit (sidetext) and range

entries.notes: Not a stored OrcaSlicer setting: it is defined in TemperaturesConfigDef as a custom-G-code placeholder, and the same file lists bed_temperature among keys it ignores on config import. A requirement on it is a plate-independent bound; OrcaSlicer stores bed temperature per build-plate type in the filament preset; the active plate selects which of hot_plate_temp, textured_plate_temp, cool_plate_temp and eng_plate_temp is used.
